A '''planet''' existed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Unidentified clone trooper (Post 473)|clone trooper]] destroyed a bridge which led to a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony in order to stop a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] convoy.
